svg.aria-label: A bench rig that explains dynamic batching. A tray of 32 slots holds the requests being served. A sliding shutter sets how many slots are open, a feed rail on the left holds the queue, and a dial gauge shows the p99 latency against a red SLA zone. When latency crosses the red zone the shutter is pulled back by a quarter; otherwise it moves out along a rack, one step, then two, then four.
